findings.text: The head-arm gate recorded at the reviewed head runs three files (tests/test_a_concurrent_launch_is_refused.py, tests/test_a_worker_on_another_host_refuses_a_relaunch.py, tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py), while the node's done_when names four files that must add no failure including tests/test_a_resume_never_launches_beside_another_node.py and tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py. Those two are covered only by four-file-head.log, whose header reads revision 42484b4484 and so predates the two commits under review; their no-failure receipt is therefore not re-measured at abe41ae3c9.

The docstring justifies not storing the failure on the pointer with the universal claim that no later launch clears it, but reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3039 builds a fresh run record and :3494 writes it over pointer_path(run_id) wholesale, so a later launch of the same run through the dispatch door replaces the pointer and would clear the field. The behaviour (report on stderr, store nothing) is sound; the stated reason is unqualified and the same sentence is published to readers in docs/evidence/fragments/a-run-has-one-live-worker/the-launch-reservation-leaves-no-stray-state.html.
